title: Best Plush Toy (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products that appear in at least one source, prioritized those mentioned by multiple sites. Sources used: Tom’s Guide (SquishPillow), Taste of Home (Warmies, Hugz, Hugimals).
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.

verdict.line: Warmies is ideal for adults and kids who want a calming, weighted hug. It offers a soothing pressure that eases anxiety and can be heated or cooled for extra comfort. The catch: it is heavier than some other plush options, which may be less portable.
